overview: The City Council approved on first reading an ordinance establishing a marijuana licensing selection committee, endorsed state legislation to guarantee housing stability during the pandemic, and received an update from the city clerk on preparations for the general election. The council also resolved to meet with delivery companies regarding traffic and parking practices and cleared several backlogged committee reports and tabled items.

items.title: Common Victualler License for Helen's Roast Beef and Pizzeria
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for Helen's Roast Beef and Pizzeria at 321A Boston Avenue, with the petitioner advised to apply separately if seeking to operate past 11:00 p.m.

items.title: FY 2021 State Budget and City Revenue Update Request
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking the administration and finance director for an update on the fiscal year 2021 state budget and its local revenue impacts.

items.title: Marijuana Establishment Selection Committee Ordinance
items.summary: Approved on first reading an ordinance creating a five-member selection committee chaired by the police chief to rank and interview adult-use cannabis applicants and recommend host community agreements.

items.title: Delivery Driver Traffic and Parking Practices
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution inviting representatives from Amazon, Uber, and Lyft to meet with the council regarding safety and traffic concerns caused by drivers stopping in travel lanes.

items.title: Open Meeting Law Inquiry for Meetings Extending Past Midnight
items.summary: Approved a request for a city solicitor opinion on whether posted meetings running past midnight into the next day create potential Open Meeting Law violations.

items.title: Park Medford Office Hours Review
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the administration review its agreement with Park Medford to ensure the Main Street office stays open past 2:00 p.m. at least one evening per week.

items.title: Non-ADA Compliant Sidewalks and Accessibility
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting an inventory and compliance plan for non-ADA compliant sidewalks, along with a renewed request for an update on outdoor dining sidewalk access issues.

items.title: Massport CAC Update on FAA Flight Path Decision
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution seeking an update from Medford's Massport Community Advisory Committee representatives following the FAA's rejection of flight dispersion concepts, with notice to the federal delegation.

items.title: Resolution Supporting Housing Stability Act (H5018)
items.summary: Approved a resolution endorsing state legislation to prevent evictions and foreclosures during the COVID-19 emergency, to be sent to state legislative leaders and Governor Baker.

items.title: General Election Preparations Update
items.summary: City Clerk Adam Hurtubise reported that over 13,500 mail-in and absentee ballots had been issued for the November election, early voting begins Saturday, and polling locations are fully staffed.

items.title: Committee Reports and Tabled Matters
items.summary: Accepted Committee of the Whole reports regarding donation bins, a behavioral health commission, cannabis licensing, rodent control, and a historic district, and received several old papers and reviews while referring animal control ordinance recommendations for review.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the regular meeting of October 6, 2020.

items.title: Condolences and Municipal Aggregation Request
items.summary: Adopted condolence resolutions for Mary Byrne and Giuseppe "Nick" Mascarelli, and agreed to schedule a Committee of the Whole meeting with Alicia Hunt for an update on the municipal aggregation program.
